turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not consider any other for my son's wife, O-lan. You will rest easy, I swear it on my honor as a husband and father.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Father, I will do everything to make you proud and to bring honor to our family, just as Mother always taught me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, do not speak of honor and pride now, just see to my wishes and make sure the maid is well taken care of after I am gone.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will do my best to take care of myself, honorable mother. You have always been kind to me, and I am grateful for your concern.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, you must take care of the maid, she will need someone to look after her when I am gone.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, don't worry about me, I will take care of the maid and make sure she is happy and safe, you can rest now and know that everything will be alright.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you worrying about me, too. You must rest and get stronger, for my sake and for the sake of our son.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must see him married, Wang Lung, before I go. It is my duty, my wish, and my last thought.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, I know this is your wish, and I will not deny you this. But how can you think of such things when you are so weak and your health is failing?

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I know you mean well, but I must see this through. The son's future is secure, and it is my duty to ensure his happiness before I go.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about me, I am already settled and happy with the maid. You must take care of yourself and rest

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you are happy, son, but I am not at peace until you are married and have a child to carry on our family line

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not worry about this now, you must rest and get well

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am not afraid of dying, Wang Lung, but I am afraid of leaving you and our son without someone to care for you both.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not speak of leaving me, O-lan. I will take care of our son, and he will take care of me. You must rest now, and do not worry about the future.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest, I will take care of Father and help him with everything. You mustn't worry about us, I'm grown now and can take care of myself.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not rest easy, knowing that you are not settled. You must find a good wife, as I did, and start a family of your own.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about me, I will find a good wife, I promise. I will be happy and prosperous, just as you and Father have always taught me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: It is not just a matter of finding a good wife, my son. I want to see you settled with a woman who will take care of you and honor your family's name.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will make you proud, I promise to find a good wife and settle down, just as you want. I'll start looking right away, don't worry about me.
